environment.description: Go Gin application deployed as a container on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with public internet access. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to the target group. No additional authentication layer exists between the internet and the application. The RSA public key PEM file is baked into the container image at /opt/keys/public.pem and is also publicly accessible via the /.well-known/jwks.json endpoint on the same service (served by a sidecar).

config.auth_layer: None - ALB passes all requests through
config.tls: ALB terminates TLS, forwards HTTP to container
